method.source_hash_and_artifact_verification: The exact handoff JSONL SHA and every artifact SHA declared by all four handoff records were rechecked; all 138 artifact entries match. Each candidate remote ref tip was fetched and matched the full pinned commit.
method.fixed_view_review: Inspected each actual eight-view contact sheet and the full-size fixed hero pixels; all eight fixed-frame hashes match each render manifest and exact GLB hash.
method.runtime_pixel_review: Inspected each actual Chromium/Three runtime contact sheet and full-size hero pixels. All seven runtime images per asset match the evidence-manifest byte count and SHA, and the manifests/runtime reports bind to the exact GLB SHA.
method.blend_glb_review: Blender 4.3.2 opened the exact .blend files with auto-execution disabled, inspected each EXPORT collection, imported the exact GLB, and compared triangle counts and object bounds. All match; no source degenerate faces or non-finite vertices.
method.reconstruction_review: For each asset, both saved bounded-runner rebuild records have succeeded/returncode 0; run-result hashes and output GLB hashes were rechecked. Both outputs per asset are byte-identical to the selected GLB, and each comparison report marks semantic_match=true. No rebuild was repeated during this QA.
method.profile_review: Read the pinned profile contract, profile report, legacy report, and 2026-10-18.1 profile rules. No profile checker or test suite was rerun.

cross_item_limits: The content verdict does not certify strict specimen-level, species-level, measured-locality, microcrystal, or field-event accuracy. The metadata explicitly bounds these as original inspired/teaching concepts with artistic nominal scale.
The static profile contract can be compatible while the candidate remains unapproved. The required hardware-GPU stage is still unknown.
Legacy reports retain the historical consulted-only license-key validation failures; no third-party license was guessed, and the references are declared consulted-only with no incorporated media.

assets.content_decision: PASS within the pinned, explicitly stylized teaching-art claim scope
assets.independent_visual_observation: The shell and enclosed animal read as a single teaching subject in hero, reverse, front, side and top views. The two real openings, tube wall, exposed introvert and small posterior end remain legible; the calm color and blunt sparse spines stay child-friendly. Smooth shading is intentional and does not hide a structural defect.

metadata_claim_scope.en: Original Selkirkia-inspired static teaching animal: a slightly tapering unmineralized sheath has real wall thickness and two open ends. A continuous worm remains inside with radial clearance; only its anterior ring-toothed introvert and a small posterior end project beyond the openings. Sparse blunt ring teeth, color, size and posture are artistic, not exact count, calcium shell or locomotion claims.
metadata_claim_scope.zh: 原创Selkirkia启发静态教学动物：略渐细非矿化鞘管有真实壁厚及双端开口；连续虫体在管内留径向间隙，前部环齿吻和少量后端从开口伸出。稀疏钝齿、配色尺度姿态属美术概括，非精确计数/钙壳/运动机制。

No fertile organ, whole parent plant, roots, mixed taxa, Umkomasia or Pteruchus added. The frozen brief pose contains an inherited fertile-fragment template phrase; it is explicitly inapplicable to this foliage-only model and metadata.

assets.independent_visual_observation: The intersecting mineral fins form open, unequal cells attached to a finite eroded host face. Top, side and reverse views preserve varied cell geometry and fin heights; the surface reads as a stylized geological exposure rather than an equal grid or detached panels.

metadata_claim_scope.en: Original cave-boxwork teaching exposure: thin intersecting mineral fins with real thickness form irregular open cells attached to one finite eroded rock face, with unequal heights and residual-rock thickness hierarchy. The generic speleogen concept represents more resistant fracture filling exposed by host erosion, not ordinary dripping stalagmite growth, an equal grid, detached panels or a three-dimensional reticulite foam. Nominal65cm patch, mineral palette and display face are artistic; no cave locality or microcrystal claim.
